scope: Independent read-only recomputation from original CSV and saved forecasts; no model training, network requests, or original report writes. Numerical comparison tolerance 1e-12. Not a February accuracy test.

pre_holdout_selection.selection_timing_caveat: Chronological subset of previously saved folds; no claim that this choice was prospectively preregistered.

details.note: Data quantities were independently recalculated above; documentation may subsequently receive edits.

limitations: CSV timezone and interval convention remain assumptions.
Equal-weight farm_proxy is dimensionless; turbine nominal capacities and normalization are not supplied.
Seven January weather folds and one holdout issue are narrow historical evidence, not season-wide validation.
Five-fold holdout split is retrospectively derived from existing predictions and has disjoint target hours; it does not prove preregistration.
Forecast snapshots retain January measurements through February; final measurement-hour end is 671 hours before the last replay issue.
Last-Modified supports preserved object-version timing but cannot reconstruct first publication history.
This check verifies stored forecast provenance timestamps, not a fresh NOAA network response.
